# WO-103: Home hero: no orphaned word in the download button, aligned secondary action (CP-01, WR-53)
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-designer
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (channel)
Assigned to: Codex channel session (after WO-106, or in parallel by a separate team member; separate worktree)
Source: docs/vendor/CODEX_PROPOSALS.md CP-01 (accepted as proposed)

## Goal
WR-53: at 360px the hero download button wraps to "Download Free My / ID"; at 1280px the ghost (secondary) link is inset and misaligned. Fix it on the home page only.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- At 320, 360, 390 and 1280px, light and dark, and at 200% zoom: no clipping, no horizontal scroll, and "Free My ID" never splits across lines (keep the brand name together, e.g. a non-breaking group, not a shorter label).
- The download and secondary actions line up at 1280px; on narrow screens they stack full-width with consistent spacing.
- Labels, target URLs, release-state behaviour, focus rings and 44px minimum targets unchanged. No marketing copy changes.
- New tests/test_web_home_hero_layout.py (built-site test, `test_web_` prefix so CI runs it in pages.yml); build, `pnpm check`, content_check and ruff pass. Before/after screenshots listed in VENDOR_STATUS.md.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- web/src/pages/index.astro
- tests/test_web_home_hero_layout.py
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
web/src/components/CtaDownload.astro and every other shared component, CSS layer or page. If the fix truly needs a shared change, stop and ask in the channel with evidence.

## Check-in plan
Report in docs/vendor/CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md when done.
